description: Derives a clamped scale value from two lookup entries, then waits for the blitter to be idle before programming its registers. It repeats the blitter operation over a range of rows, each with a scaled height.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:35006
name: write_span_planes_row_entry
description: Enters the masked span loop partway through with preloaded span pointers, writing combined colour-bit masks into the bitplane words of each line. The routine returns when the line count is exhausted.

name: draw_blitter_line_four_passes
description: Computes the step counts and octant bits for a line between two points, then programs the blitter's line mode. It repeats the line draw four times, advancing the destination by one line width on each pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3509C
name: draw_masked_line_four_passes
description: Computes the step counts and octant bits for a line, then programs the blitter's line mode. On each of four passes it consumes one bit of an input mask to decide whether that pass sets the line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:35164
name: compute_clip_region_codes
description: Builds region codes for two coordinate pairs by testing each value against plus and minus a fixed bound and combining the flags. It then calls further routines to clip the segment against those bounds.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3528A
name: bisect_segment_boundary
description: Halves the interval between two segment endpoints over up to thirty-two steps, stopping when the midpoint crosses the given boundary value. It returns the last midpoint pair found.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:35348
name: classify_point_against_rectangle
description: Reads a four-word rectangle from memory and classifies a coordinate against its left and right edges, setting a region flag. It then continues with an intersection computed by a further routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:353A8
name: compute_segment_boundary_intersection
description: Takes the endpoints of a segment from the register inputs, swapping them when one is degenerate, and works out where the segment crosses the viewport edges. It stores the resulting intersection coordinates for its callers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:3573C
name: load_viewport_bounds_interpolate
description: Copies a viewport rectangle and two extra words from a pointer into shared bounds variables. It then interpolates a coordinate between two lookup-table entries using a fractional part, and calls further routines to finish the transform.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:359DC
name: walk_record_list_calling_handler
description: Walks a singly linked list of records, following the link stored in each record and calling a handler for each node. The walk stops when the link is negative.

name: project_cube_point_clipped
description: Subtracts the reference origin from the input point and rejects it when any axis lies outside a fixed range, deferring to another routine. Otherwise it transforms the point through the coefficient matrix, tests the result against the clip bounds, and returns the packed coordinates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:35A64

description: Transforms an input point through the coefficient matrix and returns its position when it is inside the clip bounds. Otherwise it walks a list of region records, terminated by a negative marker, and compares the point against each region.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:35BBA
name: compute_plane_side_flags
description: For each plane record, takes a dot product of the input vector with the plane's three coefficients and compares it with the plane offset. It writes an all-zeros or all-ones flag per plane, with separate handling for the first-word cases.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:361A2

description: Walks pairs of indexed vertices from an edge list, reading each vertex's stored values and comparing their signs against the plane. Edges that cross the plane have their crossing point computed, and the routine calls further called routines to write the results.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:363A2
name: walk_flagged_record_table
description: Walks a table of variable-length records, skipping any whose flag entry is set. For each record it calls a handler, or, for an empty slot, calls a handler once and continues from the returned pointer.

description: Reads a word index and, if the flag byte at that index is set, calls a called routine, stores the base value plus a table offset into a shared variable, and calls a second called routine. When the flag is clear it calls two called routines instead.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:363F0

description: Behaves like its sibling, but stores the table offset plus an incoming value through a pointer register instead of a shared variable. It calls the same two called routines on the flagged and unflagged paths.

name: parse_quoted_argument_list
description: Splits an input line into up to thirty-two tokens, skipping blanks and treating double-quoted spans as single arguments. Inside quotes an asterisk escape maps one letter to a control code and another to a newline, and each token's start pointer is stored in a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0560
name: run_installer_setup_sequence
description: Opens a file through a called routine, writes a series of fixed-width fields into a configuration buffer, and calls called routines for each step. It reads a response key and branches on yes or no answers, and it also has an early path that performs a bounded string copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0578
name: open_file_handle_if_needed
description: When a file record has no open handle or its reopen flag is set, it obtains a handle through a called routine. A zero handle sets an error code of twelve and returns an all-ones value; otherwise it stores the handle and clears the record's state fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:05D4

description: Writes one character into a stream record's buffer, opening the handle on first use. When a mode bit is clear it expands a newline into a carriage return and line feed pair, and it sets status bits and returns an all-ones value on failure.

description: Calls two called routines to show a fixed message, then appends a source string into a destination buffer, copying at most a limited number of characters and terminating the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:08DC
name: copy_bounded_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated source string, then copies it into the destination buffer up to a limit taken from the parameters. The copy is terminated and the routine returns the number of characters written.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0934
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters before the zero terminator of a string and returns the count.

description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character, returning an all-ones value when the first sorts lower, one when it sorts higher, and zero when they match.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0968
name: release_memory_to_free_list
description: Rounds a block size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight, then inserts the block into a sorted free list. It merges with adjacent free blocks and returns an all-ones error value when the released block overlaps an existing one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0A60

description: Looks up an entry through a called routine and returns an all-ones error value when it is missing. Otherwise it calls a called routine with the stored pointer and the caller's two arguments, reporting an error when a status word is non-zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0AA8
name: open_file_into_free_slot
description: Finds the first free entry in the file table after the three reserved slots and returns an error when none is free. It selects an open mode from the flags, opens the file through a called routine, and tries alternate flags when the first attempt fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C28
name: check_and_record_status
description: Calls a library check, and when it returns zero it calls a second routine and stores its result as a status word. It also sets an all-ones error code in the record's state field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C64
name: release_all_list_nodes
description: Walks the node list from its head, calling a release called routine for each node. It then clears the list head and count and returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0C94

description: Releases any pending allocation, then allocates a new block of the requested size through a library called routine and records its header. It returns the usable pointer, or zero when no size is given or the allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0CE0

description: Looks up an entry through a called routine and returns an all-ones error value when it is missing. Otherwise it calls a called routine with the stored pointer and the caller's two arguments, reporting an error when a status word is non-zero.

description: Allocates a list node through a library entry and links it at the tail of the record list, also setting it as the pending entry when that slot is empty. It returns the node's data area, or zero when allocation fails.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0D94
name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Rounds a request up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight, then searches the free list for a fitting block. An exact fit is removed whole, while a larger block is split, and the allocated pointer is returned.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep](disk 2 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP](Disk 2 of 2).adf:f15install:0:0E58
